brief: The AI content business model. Audience first, then product. The exact funnel of indie content founders earning $20k/mo.

slots.headline: Turn AI Content Into $20K/mo
slots.body: Discover how indie creators turn AI‑generated content into a reliable $20k/month revenue stream by prioritizing audience before product.

slots.title: Step 1: Build a Niche Audience
slots.body: Identify a passionate micro‑niche, engage daily on LinkedIn, and grow a mailing list of 2k+ engaged followers.

slots.title: Step 2: Validate With Free Value
slots.body: Offer free AI‑driven insights or templates, collect feedback, and refine your value proposition based on real user needs.

slots.title: Step 3: Create a Paid Mini‑Course
slots.body: Package your top‑performing AI prompts into a low‑ticket mini‑course; price $49 and validate demand quickly.

slots.title: Step 4: Launch a Subscription
slots.body: Turn the mini‑course into a monthly membership with fresh prompts, community Q&A, and exclusive tools for $29.

slots.title: Step 5: Scale With Partnerships
slots.body: Partner with SaaS tools or agencies, co‑create content, and earn referral commissions while expanding reach.

slots.title: Step 6: Automate & Optimize
slots.body: Automate prompt delivery with Zapier, track churn, and reinvest earnings into paid ads to hit $20k.

slots.headline: Start Your $20K Journey Today
slots.body: Ready to build your AI content empire? Grab the free blueprint and start earning today.
